method: Chromium (Playwright) against the release code (branch claude/wonderful-bardeen-s9k90x at b94449a, what production will run) serving a local PostgreSQL replica (database replica_g2, loopback only). The Monday-page approval of the clearance and cover items was simulated on this replica only by a local staff user, bound to the exact file hashes; nothing is approved or published in production. The book was imported there with the production publisher identity and deterministic operation IDs: edition 899f8c17-dd85-4b19-82a0-a03f4d8d40ff, revision 3dac775e-d883-4c85-ae88-2275fcbfd19e, and all 155 unit/anchor IDs and texts identical to the export_audiovisual_source output of that revision. Signed in as a staff publisher; desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844; the title page (covers) and the reader (text). Its one author footnote (a note block) renders as p.footnote with its own data-anchor, counted in the paragraph total and in order.
criteria: every paragraph rendered in order with its exact anchor and text
front and back cover images load (800x1200)
